title: ADR-010: Keep the serverless baseline; allow an optional local-services deployment
summary: Keeps AVARICE's serverless baseline and makes an optional localhost local-services deployment supported, gated by enterprise profile rules.
notes: Status reads 'Proposed' (not 'Accepted'), so locked is false despite ADR type. Amends ADR-003 and ADR-004 for the baseline only. Type and precedence supplied by manifest. Output filename uses no source hash because the classifier has no hashing tool; the synthesizer should match on source_path.
